QUOTE: MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY undefined ─────────► calloc() directly (platform.h:167)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer's headline claims the default build uses function pointers in platform.c, and it only mentions the direct-calloc path as the "MEMORY undefined" case. It never concludes that a default build has no indirection or that the two are preprocessor macros expanding to calloc and free.
